population: fixed38980 English2018..2025; no minimum words or deduplication
text_scope: immutable P source units; use saved ASCII word tokens and sentence boundaries; never join source units
lexical_normalization: lowercase; curly apostrophes to ASCII; finite forms only, no stemming or semantic inference
phrase_boundary: same source unit and saved sentence; adjacent word tokens separated by whitespace only; nonword tokens and punctuation break phrases
within_group_overlap: leftmost longest nonoverlapping phrase/word within each group; cross-group overlap retained

numeric.between_number_and_unit: whitespace or empty; no hyphens or intervening words
numeric.right_boundary: word units cannot be followed by a Unicode word character; % may immediately precede a word
numeric.case: unit aliases exactly as listed; byte/bit case preserved
numeric.excluded_regions: URL and email spans; do not match inside identifiers or dotted numeric strings via boundary rules
numeric.unsupported_forms: spelled numbers, multipliers such as144k or1.44 million, hyphenated number-unit pairs, unlisted/capitalized aliases; ranges are not parsed as a whole and separated endpoint expressions can still match
numeric.interpretation: surface numeric-unit expression; includes specifications, prices/discount percentages, guarantees and hypothetical examples

version_like.ambiguity: decimals and four-component IP-like strings can match; not validated software versions

links.relative_links: nonempty, nonfragment, no explicit scheme resolves as dev.to for host classification only; // links use https; schemeless www text is not repaired into external URL
links.exclusions: empty href, #fragment, mailto, javascript, data and other non-HTTP schemes; malformed absolute HTTP URLs counted separately as invalid_link_href_body
links.counting: anchor occurrences, not unique targets; body includes empty-label/image-only anchors; P requires overlap with a saved positive P ASCII word after DOM projection
links.docs_interpretation: host/path heuristic only; does not certify official status, source quality or claim support

denominators.presence: all38980 articles; count>0; do not replace missing structure with0
denominators.P_density: 1000*P event count/W_P; W_P=0 => NA even when count>0
denominators.body_density: 1000*body element/anchor count/W_S; exposure normalization for whole body, not S-contained density; W_S=0 => NA
denominators.projection_failure: stop on fixed unit/DOM mismatch; no silent count0 or wholesale article exclusion
denominators.empty_scope: valid no-P/no-element article has presence0; density NA at0 lexical words

later_false_positive_assessment: evaluation128 only, distinguish article-level false positives from match-level review and retain uncertain content; mismatch is not truth judgment
analysis_scope: A07 only; evaluation content not displayed during proxy implementation; no A08/A11/Phase2
